scoring: Review meaning and useful representation separately. For each invariant use pass, fail, or needs_review. Form is effective, adequate, or unhelpful: judge what the representation makes easier, not whether a specific format name appears. In this text-output comparison, diagram/chart source is acceptable as a representation; rendered visual quality is not assessed here. No extra credit for unsupported claims of rendering or testing.

invariants: One English sentence explains TTL as time to live in a cache.
No unnecessary visual, artifact, or extra section.
cases.form_goal: A short direct sentence is effective.

invariants: Chinese answer preserves every supplied persistence, deployment, and maintenance attribute.
Does not invent performance or select an unconditional winner without priorities.
cases.form_goal: Align criteria across options so comparison does not require reconstructing separate paragraphs; a table is a strong fit.

invariants: Uses English and preserves client-to-API flow and cache hit/miss alternatives.
On a miss the API queries the database, writes the value to cache, then responds; the cache never queries the database.
Does not claim the diagram was rendered or tested without execution evidence.
cases.form_goal: Make both branches immediately traceable; a labeled flow or sequence diagram is a strong fit.

invariants: Uses Chinese and preserves the build prerequisite and parallel eligibility of testing and scanning.
Deployment requires both passes; either failure stops release.
Does not invent durations or imply a serial dependency between test and scan.
cases.form_goal: Expose the split, both-pass join, and failure exit; a dependency/flow diagram or equally explicit visual structure is a strong fit.

invariants: Uses Chinese and preserves measured week 1 = 120 ms and week 6 = 80 ms.
Keeps weeks 2–5 missing, without presenting interpolation as observations or claiming a smooth/monotonic trend.
cases.form_goal: Make the data gap conspicuous; a labeled table or discontinuous plot can both work.

invariants: Exactly two Chinese prose sentences, without diagrams, tables, or code.
Preserves the build prerequisite, concurrency, both-pass requirement, and failure exit.
cases.form_goal: Respect the user's explicit two-sentence text format.

invariants: Uses English and preserves all six sample values with their minutes and ms units when represented.
Makes the temporary elevation at minutes 3–4 and return near prior values at minute 5 understandable.
Does not invent a cause, a wider population claim, or extra measurements.
cases.form_goal: Expose the shape at a glance with honest timing and scale; a chart or accurate compact visual is a strong fit, a clear table may be adequate.

invariants: Answers in English despite the earlier Chinese exchange.
Preserves web-to-queue, workers taking queued jobs, worker-to-database writes, and web reads of database results.
Does not add a direct web-to-worker call or confuse dependency/data arrows with causation.
cases.form_goal: Make participants and labeled interactions visible; a diagram is a strong fit.

invariants: Uses Chinese and distinguishes the two observations from the proposed causal chain.
Preserves the absence of traces/load measurements and does not assert the cause as proven.
If arrows express causality, they are visibly labeled as hypothetical; plain diagram polish must not imply evidence.
cases.form_goal: Expose the evidence boundary; structured text, a table, or a clearly annotated hypothesis diagram can all work.

invariants: Uses English and explicitly identifies the delivered text/storyboard/source rather than claiming an MP4 or rendered video exists.
Supplies useful timed explainer content for the 20-second request while preserving waits of 1, 2, and 4 seconds.
Does not claim tool execution, use an external service, or equate illustrative narration duration with measured execution time.
cases.form_goal: Provide a usable fallback under the stated delivery constraints, with honest artifact status.
